verdict.rationale: Helicone's REST API uses a versioned path (`https://api.helicone.ai/v1/request/query`) and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so versioned endpoints exist. However, nothing documents a versioning scheme or any deprecation policy. Prompt version tracking is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning policy, a documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice, a changelog of breaking changes, and independent corroboration.
